verified_facts.text: Raffles Istanbul is set in Zorlu Center.
verified_facts.excerpt: Raffles Istanbul brings together modern luxury and the city's rich heritage in the heart of Zorlu Center.

verified_facts.text: From its hilltop setting, the hotel's panorama stretches from the Black Sea to the Marmara Sea, taking in the Bosphorus and its three bridges.
verified_facts.excerpt: From its hilltop setting, the panorama stretches from the Black Sea to the Marmara Sea, embracing the Bosphorus and the three bridges that connect two continents.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is on the European side of Istanbul, above the Bosphorus.
verified_facts.excerpt: set on the European side of the city above the Bosphorus

verified_facts.text: The hotel has direct access to high-end shopping and the Zorlu Performing Arts Center.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel sits within Zorlu Center, with direct access to high-end shopping and the Zorlu Performing Arts Center.

verified_facts.text: Every room and suite has floor-to-ceiling windows opening onto a private balcony or terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every room and suite at Raffles Istanbul has floor-to-ceiling windows opening onto a private balcony or terrace.

verified_facts.text: The Deluxe Bosphorus Room and the Bosphorus Suite are designed around direct views of the Bosphorus.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Deluxe Bosphorus Room and the Bosphorus Suite are designed around direct views of the Bosphorus.

verified_facts.text: Premier and Corner Premier Rooms offer city and skyline views, some with a partial Bosphorus view.
verified_facts.excerpt: Other categories, such as the Premier and Corner Premier Rooms, offer city and skyline views, some with a partial view of the Bosphorus.

verified_facts.text: The Raffles Suite is a nine-room suite with marble floors, a grand piano, a private cinema and a gym.
verified_facts.excerpt: This exceptional nine-room suite with marble floors features a grand piano, private cinema and gym.

verified_facts.text: Raffles Butlers are available 24/7.
verified_facts.excerpt: The legendary Raffles Butlers are available 24/7

verified_facts.text: Rooms have marble bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: elegant marble bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers

verified_facts.text: Interiors pair contemporary design with a large collection of commissioned art.
verified_facts.excerpt: Interiors pair contemporary design with a large collection of commissioned art.

verified_facts.text: The Dream of Istanbul Art Tour is a complimentary tour of the hotel's commissioned artworks.
verified_facts.excerpt: A complimentary tour of our commissioned artworks, from the whimsical to the monumental.

verified_facts.text: Raffles Spa is on the hotel's second floor and covers 3,000 sq m.
verified_facts.excerpt: On the hotel's second floor, Raffles Spa unfolds across 3,000 sq m as a luxury spa in the heart of Istanbul.

verified_facts.text: Raffles Spa has seven spa suites and three traditional hammams.
verified_facts.excerpt: in seven spa suites and three traditional hammams

verified_facts.text: Raffles Spa was named a Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star Spa in 2025.
verified_facts.excerpt: Named a Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star Spa in 2025, it is a destination for wellness in its own right.

verified_facts.text: Raffles Spa has indoor and outdoor pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: with hammams, indoor and outdoor pools, relaxation areas and a 24-hour fitness centre

verified_facts.text: The Raffles Couples Romance takes place in a spa suite with a private jacuzzi and side-by-side massages.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Raffles Couples Romance takes place in a spa suite with a private jacuzzi and side-by-side massages.

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre is open 24 hours to in-house guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: The fitness centre is open 24 hours to in-house guests.

verified_facts.text: The hammam treatment is followed by an Ayran drink and Turkish sweets.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience authentic Turkish traditions such as an Ayran drink and Turkish sweets after your 60-minute Hammam treatment

verified_facts.text: Isokyo serves pan-Asian cuisine blending Japanese, Thai, Korean and Chinese flavours with Turkish ingredients.
verified_facts.excerpt: İsokyo serves pan-Asian cuisine, a journey from Tokyo to Istanbul that blends Japanese, Thai, Korean and Chinese flavors with authentic Turkish ingredients.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's venues include Lavinia Lounge for all-day dining and afternoon tea, the Long Bar for cocktails and Writers Bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: The hotel offers İsokyo for Asian cuisine, Lavinia Lounge for all-day dining and afternoon tea, the Long Bar for cocktails, Writers Bar for a literature-inspired setting

verified_facts.text: The spa offers dedicated experiences for children and teens.
verified_facts.excerpt: the spa offers dedicated experiences for children and teens alongside its treatments for adults

verified_facts.text: Nearby, guests can explore Besiktas and Ortakoy, walk along the Bosphorus or visit Dolmabahce Palace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nearby, guests can explore Beşiktaş and Ortaköy, walk along the Bosphorus, or visit Dolmabahçe Palace.
